subtitulo: Your full-service sourcing and foreign trade partner, with direct support in Asia and Latin America.
descripcion: We coordinate your entire international trade operation end to end, so you have a single point of contact instead of several disconnected vendors.
queHacemos: Full planning and coordination of the international supply chain
Cargo consolidation and purchase order management across multiple manufacturers
Customs documentation oversight and regulatory compliance at origin and destination
Real-time tracking with progress reports at every milestone
Final warehouse delivery with a transparent cost breakdown

beneficios.descripcion: No more juggling 5 different intermediaries. Kattya and her team centralize all technical communication.
Open, detailed cost structures before any goods ship.
Long-term relationships with strategic advice tailored to your company's goals.
Direct on-the-ground supervision in China to resolve any issue immediately.

etapas.detalle: We evaluate your technical requirements, purchase volumes, and delivery timelines.
Closing commercial terms (Incoterms) while protecting your interests.
Manufacturing oversight with quality testing before dispatch.
Ocean freight and expedited customs clearance to your warehouse.

specs.Cobertura: Asia (mainland China) to Peru and all of Latin America
specs.Modalidad: FCL (Full Container Load) and turnkey projects
specs.Incoterms usuales: FOB, CIF, DDP depending on client needs
specs.Soporte: Direct support from Kattya Mejía and a bilingual operations team
